cli.description: GenuineCI command-line tool for managing CI/CD and secrets.

login.description: Log in to a local or remote GenuineCI server.

flags.local: Log in to local Docker environment (http://localhost:8080).
flags.teamId: Team to select when you belong to more than one team.
flags.firebaseApiKey: Firebase Web API key (override for a self-hosted Firebase project).

login.teamRequired: Multiple teams found. Run login again with --team-id from the list above.

use.description: Set the default display language (japanese, english).
use.invalidLanguage: Invalid language "${input}". Supported languages: japanese, english.

dev.description: Manage local development environment (Docker, Tart, DB, Server).

start.description: Start local services and run the Mac Orchard Worker until Ctrl+C.

flags.seed: Queue the default smoke-test build job after starting services.

sync.description: Sync local workflow definitions with GenuineCI.

paths.description: Generate genuine_ci/paths.g.dart from the pubspec.yaml workspace.
paths.noArguments: sync paths does not accept positional arguments.
paths.projectRootNotFound: No project containing pubspec.yaml and a genuine_ci directory found. Run this command from your workflow project.
paths.fileAccessFailed: Could not read or write ${path}. Check that the file exists and you have permission to access it.

secrets.noArguments: sync secrets does not accept positional arguments.
secrets.loginRequired: Run genuineci login (or genuineci login --local) before syncing secrets.
